title: Predictive Online Disturbance-Action Control for Linear Dynamical Systems
summary: This paper studies predictive online control for linear dynamical systems with time-varying cost functions, motivated by applications such as real-time adaptive control of motorized LiDAR sensing systems, where the controller must adjust the sensing direction online to balance localization accuracy, scanning efficiency, and smooth actuation under changing environmental conditions. We propose a predictive online control (POC) algorithm that leverages short-term predictions of future cost functions while accounting for the memory effect induced by system dynamics.
